title: Next-generation CsPbBr3 perovskite nanocrystal chloride sensors: stability engineering and halide-exchange mechanisms in aqueous, biological, and environmental media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26689-26710
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09798C, Review Article

Mohamed Abu Shuheil, Ahmed Aldulaimi, Subhashree Ray, Talal Aziz Qassem, Gunjan Garg, Renu Sharma, Dilbar Urazbaeva, Sabokhat Sadikova, Sharmin Smaeilpour
Stability-engineered CsPbBr3 nanocrystals enable reversible chloride sensing through Br−/Cl− exchange, causing lattice contraction and a predictable green-to-blue photoluminescence shift for portable optical detection.
